document.title: BRS-161016 Test VP mold #9 dry 150°C 1Hr / 2Hr to improve VP bending
document.purpose: Test VP mold #9 dry 150°C 1Hr and 2Hr to improve VP bending.
content: Check NG rate of laser cutting VP

conclusions.statement_from_report: VP test happen NG cutting is high; NG rate bending is reduce.
conclusions.normalized_interpretation: 1Hr 6.80% vs Normal 3.5% = 1.943x, 94.3% worse. 2Hr 5.44% vs Normal 3.5% = 1.554x, 55.4% worse. Both dry conditions worsen laser cutting NG.
1Hr 0.365% vs Normal 0.864% = 0.422x, 57.8% improved. 2Hr 0.36% vs Normal 0.864% = 0.417x, 58.3% improved. Bending halved in both conditions.

conclusions.statement_from_report: NG rate of function of VP test is higher than normal VP mold #9.
conclusions.normalized_interpretation: 1Hr 6.96% vs Normal 1.978% = 3.518x, 251.8% worse. 2Hr 8.06% vs Normal 1.978% = 4.075x, 307.5% worse. Function NG very large penalty under both dry conditions.

conclusions.statement_from_report: => So Can not use VP mold #9 test dry 150°C in 1hour, 2hour.
conclusions.normalized_interpretation: Bending improved, but function and laser cutting NG much worse. Decision rejects 150°C 1Hr/2Hr dry.

troubleshooting_index.defect_name: VP bending / Function NG (mold #9 dry condition)

suggested_checks.reason: Function NG +252% / +307% vs Normal; laser cutting NG +55-94% vs Normal.

suggested_checks.check_item: Investigate Touch and Noise hearing NG drivers in 2Hr 150°C
suggested_checks.reason: Touch jumps to 4.76% (vs 0.36% Normal); Noise stays 3.6%.

limitations: Single trial event; sample 273-294 pcs per condition.

assumptions: Date carried-forward to Test rows from Normal (lot date 23/6) block.
warnings: Function date is 2024-06-28, vision/bending date 2024-06-27 - paired by same trial event.
ai_extraction_log.decision_rationale: Same-event Normal rows present. Bending improved (-58%) but function much worse (+250-300%). Author decision Can not use is consistent.
